### 推薦先賣

Drone EMC 來源列出 battery、BMS、ESC、flight control module、communication module、antennas and sensors 等待測風險元件線索 [42]。
Drone EMC 來源列出 conducted layout、radiated layout、80 MHz–6 GHz、horizontal / vertical mounting、idle / active mode 等測試配置線索 [43]。
Military EME / HIRF / EMP 是第二個強線索，因為 MIL-STD-464 被描述為 system-level testing standard，並列出 external RF EME、High Power Microwave、lightning、EMP、RADHAZ、E3 hardness 與 system radiated emission 等項目 [4]。
Complex EME emulation 是客製化測試線索，來源列出 emulate complex EME signals、evaluate military system level effects under EM interferences、simulate different operational scenarios [56]。
高頻高速 PCB / SI 是第三個較接近 Oscilloscope 的線索，因為 R&S PCB test solutions 來源列出 impedance TDR、DK/DF extraction、stackup selection、crosstalk、TL modeling、eye diagram、sampling testing 與 process monitoring [19]。

- [[CISPR 35]] — 來源在 international standards for drone testing 與 commercial drone standards 中列名。
- [[EN 61000-4-3]] — radiated RF immunity。
- [[EN 61000-4-6]] — conducted RF immunity。
- [[EN 61000-4-2]] — electrostatic discharge。
- [[EN 61000-4-4]] — electrical fast transient。
- [[EN 61000-4-5]] — surges。
- [[EN 61000-4-11]] — voltage dips and interruption。
- [[EN 61000-3-2]] — harmonic current emission。

- margins，6 dB margins。
- intra-system EMC。
- hull generated intermodulation interference / IMI。
- shipboard internal EME。
- multipaction。
- induced levels at antenna ports of antenna-connected receivers。
- external RF EME。
- [[High Power Microwave]] / HPM sources。
- lightning。
- [[Electromagnetic Pulse]] / EMP。
- subsystems and equipment electromagnetic interference / EMI。
- portable electronics devices and carry-on equipment requirements。
- non-developmental items / NDI and commercial items。
- electrostatic environments。
- radiation hazards / RADHAZ：HERP、HERF、HERO。
- life cycle / E3 hardness。
- electrical bonding、power current return path、antenna installations、mechanical interfaces、shock / fault / ignitable vapour protection。
- external grounds。
- TEMPEST。
- system radiated emission、EMCON、platform radiated emission。
- EM spectrum supportability。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › 來源中的 DO-160 定位
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 說 [[RTCA DO-160]] is important because it provides the minimum operational performance standards for electronic systems and equipment that support aviation to pursue increased safety, system capacity and efficiency。

來源另說其 purpose 是提供 means of determining performance characteristics of airborne equipment in environmental conditions which may be encountered in airborne operation of the equipment，並可與 applicable standards 一起作為 minimum specification。

使用限制：來源未提供 DO-160 的正式版次文件、section limit table、category matrix 或適用 drone 類型。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › 來源列出的 sections
| Section | 來源描述 |
|---:|---|
| 15 | Magnetic field / magnetic effect。 |
| 16 | Power input（electrical testing, non-EMC）。 |
| 17 | Voltage spike（AC / DC）。 |
| 18 | Audio frequency conducted susceptibility - power inputs。 |
| 19 | Induced signal susceptibility。 |
| 20 | Radio frequency susceptibility（radiated and conducted）。 |
| 21 | Emission of radio frequency energy。 |
| 22 | Lightning induced transient susceptibility。 |
| 25 | Electrostatic discharge。 |

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 15 — Magnetic Effect
來源說 Section 15 concern 為 equipment magnetic effect，目標是 finding or proving the closest distance to compasses or compass sensors（flux gates）at which that unit is allowed to be installed。

來源列出 classification：Cat Y、Cat Z、Cat A、Cat B、Class C，其中 Cat Y 被描述為 equipment next to navigation compass，Class C 被描述為 equipment >3.0 m from navigation compass。來源未提供完整 category definition。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 21 — Emission of RF Energy
來源說此測試確保 equipment does not emit excessive RF noise，以 protect aircraft sensors and receivers。來源分為：

- Conducted Emissions（low freq）。
- Radiated Emissions（high freq）。

標題中同列 [[RE102]] / CE，但未提供 limit table 或 exact mapping。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 22 — Lightning Induced Transients
來源說此測試確保 equipment can withstand a selection of fast transients intended to represent induced effects of lightning，並在頁面標題中列 [[CS117]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 25 — Electrostatic Discharge
來源說此測試確保 equipment able to withstand an air discharged electromagnetic pulse，並指出 static electricity charges can result from human contact；contributing factors include low humidity、low temperature、low conductivity、carpets、vinyl seats and plastic structures。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 問題定義
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17），簡報的 problem statement 是：

- current vulnerability of 5G [[DUT]] connections under smart-jamming；
- can legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] techniques enhance 5G resilience；
- can the connection to an unmodified 5G DUT be hardened against [[Smart Jamming]] by using legacy FH capabilities。

來源特別強調 constraint：不修改 [[DUT]]；策略應放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration around it。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]]（Version 01.00，August 2025）補充：public safety agencies、critical infrastructure industries 與 military purposes 依賴 reliable、fast、secure communications；TETRA 等傳統系統 maximum data bit rate below 30 kbit/s，無法滿足 real-time video stream 至少 2 Mbit/s 與 extended reality 至少 30 Mbit/s 的需求。

NTN test and measurement aspects
[[NTN test and measurement aspects]] 是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 NTN device、satellite、SAN、payload、phased array antenna、network 與 production testing 的總覽，涵蓋 RF、protocol、RRM、LBS、conformance、OTA、field testing 與 software-assisted testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Fading profiles and test channels
來源整理 [[TR 38.811]]、[[TR 38.901]] 與 [[TS 38.181]] 的 NTN channel model / test condition：

- [[CDL]]：clustered delay line，適用於 S-band / Ka-band，含 elevation / azimuth 的 3D model。
- [[TDL]]：tapped delay line，用於 multipath power-delay profile。
- TR 38.811 定義 NTN-CDL 與 NTN-TDL profiles，各有 LOS / NLOS profiles。
- TS 38.181 為 SAN testing 定義 NTN-TDLA100、NTN-TDLC5、moving propagation condition。
- Rel. 19 導入 NGSO time-varying Doppler shift and propagation delay channel model，用於更 realistic demodulation / RRM tests。

來源內有一項需保留的讀法限制：同段中 `NTN-TDLA100-200` 被文字描述為 100 ms delay spread，但表格對 NTN-TDLA100 列 100 ns delay spread。此處需回查原 PDF / TS 38.181。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Conformance / certification testing
來源描述 certification ecosystem 包含 certification organization、neutral test house、test equipment vendor、network operator / equipment vendor。

- NTN NB-IoT certification program 已於 late 2024 launched，聚焦 n255 / n256。
- conformance tests 在 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] 與 [[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]] umbrella 下定義。
- 來源說 GCF WI-555 描述 124 個 NTN conformance testing 相關 test cases。
- early 2026 狀態：IoT_NTN test cases 約 174；GSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 58 / 6 / 46，NGSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 56 / 8 / 0。
- 目前狀態另列 NR-NTN testing 約 RRM 93、RF 38、protocol 22 test cases。
- 2025 年 GCF 擴展 certification program，納入 NR-NTN 與 DTC certification testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

- MIL battle environment：multi-domain operations 與 complex electromagnetic environment。

Drone EMC 測試 › Drone components 與 EUT

- [[Battery]]。
- [[Battery Management System]] / [[BMS]]。

- [[Communication Module]] / [[CM]]。

來源將 commercial drone EMC 與 regulatory compliance、safety、reliability 相連，並連到 [[European EMC Directive]] 2014/30/EU 與 [[Radio Equipment Directive]] 2014/53/EU。

- default test level：3 V/m。

Airborne / drone EMC transient 與 immunity debug 是最明確的技術需求線索，因為 DO-160 來源列出 voltage spike、RF susceptibility、RF emissions、lightning induced transients 與 ESD 等 airborne equipment 測試 sections [7]。

Military EME / HIRF / EMP 是第二個強線索，因為 MIL-STD-464 被描述為 system-level testing standard，並列出 external RF EME、High Power Microwave、lightning、EMP、RADHAZ、E3 hardness 與 system radiated emission 等項目 [4]。
Complex EME emulation 是客製化測試線索，來源列出 emulate complex EME signals、evaluate military system level effects under EM interferences、simulate different operational scenarios [56]。
高頻高速 PCB / SI 是第三個較接近 Oscilloscope 的線索，因為 R&S PCB test solutions 來源列出 impedance TDR、DK/DF extraction、stackup selection、crosstalk、TL modeling、eye diagram、sampling testing 與 process monitoring [19]。

[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 說 [[RTCA DO-160]] is important because it provides the minimum operational performance standards for electronic systems and equipment that support aviation to pursue increased safety, system capacity and efficiency。

來源另說其 purpose 是提供 means of determining performance characteristics of airborne equipment in environmental conditions which may be encountered in airborne operation of the equipment，並可與 applicable standards 一起作為 minimum specification。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 22 — Lightning Induced Transients
來源說此測試確保 equipment can withstand a selection of fast transients intended to represent induced effects of lightning，並在頁面標題中列 [[CS117]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 25 — Electrostatic Discharge
來源說此測試確保 equipment able to withstand an air discharged electromagnetic pulse，並指出 static electricity charges can result from human contact；contributing factors include low humidity、low temperature、low conductivity、carpets、vinyl seats and plastic structures。
